en: Hold to lean your weight on it
One of the Abiding, the Order's hidden watch. Held alive by bound light at the post the founders gave her, four hundred years and never relieved. She believes the engine is mercy.
Warden Oan's scribe, who has kept her watch roll for four hundred years. She writes as she fights.
Only Ysolde can read the watch roll back into silence.
A Lit Age lamp-tending machine, a brass body on many fine legs. It crawls the spire's lamp-ropes trimming wicks that went out a thousand years ago.
A hanging lamp-cage on a chain. Its bound light pulses on a slow, fixed beat, steady between beats.
Moths that have lived for centuries on the spire's warm lamp-glass: glass-winged and pale.
